+# picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz_coordinate
+
+## Reason
+
+Repair the returned reduction without altering either declaration's signature or
+visibility. The existing inclusion-level differential compatibility theorem already
+contains the needed face calculation. Reuse it, rather than leave a second copy of
+that calculation as a new hole.
+
+## Old
+
+The withdrawn H3 delivery proved
+`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz` by
+coordinate-equivalence injectivity and the new coordinate theorem.
+`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz_coordinate`
+had proof `by sorry`. Both modules are absent from the current repository base.
+
+## New
+
+Keep both exact public signatures. The Leibniz theorem privately imports
+`Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PicardExternalCechCupDifferentialCoordinate` and derives
+its pure-tensor identity from the existing inclusion equation. The coordinate theorem
+privately imports the Leibniz theorem and proves its assertion by evaluation.
+Neither module contains a textual sorry. No new instance or file-level option is added.
+The choice in the theorem proof is from the already proved bidegree existence theorem;
+coordinate injectivity identifies each chosen pure-tensor value with the specified map.
+
+## Users
+
+| module | group holding it | effect |
+|---|---|---|
+| Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PicardExternalCechCupLeibniz | G3 | Same signature; complete proof from the existing differential inclusion theorem. |
+| Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PicardExternalCechCupBidegreeLeibnizCoordinate | unclaimed | Same archived signature; coordinate evaluation is proved. |
+
+There are no repository importers of these withdrawn modules at this delivery base.
+No unheld existing module is adapted. In particular, the Paper collision is independent
+of both modules; the current build probe already retries failed combined probes singly.
+
+## Status
+

+/-! # Coordinates of the external Cech Leibniz identity
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 0BED and 07MB.

+-/

+@[expose] public section
+universe w
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory Opposite
+open scoped TensorProduct
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
+noncomputable section
+variable {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}

+/-- Coordinate form of the external Cech Leibniz identity.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 07MB, signed alternating-face calculation.
+Proof: The pure-tensor Leibniz identity gives equality in the target cochain module.
+Apply the target Cech coordinate equivalence to both sides and evaluate at y.
+Congruence preserves the two degree transports, addition and the signed term.
+This also applies in degree zero, for empty index families, zero coefficients,
+and characteristic two, since it is evaluation of an existing equality.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-leibniz-coordinate). -/
+theorem picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz_coordinate
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
+    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
+    (p q : ℕ)
+    (h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj
+      (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
+      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
+        pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
+          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
+    (h₁ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X (p + 1))).obj
+      (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
+      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
+        pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
+          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X ((p + 1) + q))
+    (h₂ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj
+      (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X (q + 1)) ⟶
+      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
+        pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
+          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + (q + 1)))
+    (hh : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h)
+    (hh₁ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G (p + 1) q h₁)
+    (hh₂ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p (q + 1) h₂)
+    (a : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)
+    (b : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q)
+    (y : Fin (p + q + 2) → ι × κ) :
+    TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctorXAddEquiv
+      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)
+      (scalarPresheaf (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
+      (p + q + 1)
+      (((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
+        pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
+          (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).d (p + q) (p + q + 1) (h (a ⊗ₜ[k] b))) y =
+    TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctorXAddEquiv
+      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)
+      (scalarPresheaf (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
+      (p + q + 1)
+      ((eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
+        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
+          pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
+            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n) (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q)))
+          (h₁ (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).d p (p + 1) a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) +
+      (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
+        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
+          pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj
+            (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n) (Nat.add_assoc p q 1).symm))
+          (h₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).d q (q + 1) b))) y := by
+  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctorXAddEquiv
+    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)
+    (scalarPresheaf (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
+    (p + q + 1) z y)
+    (picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz f g U V F G p q h h₁ h₂ hh hh₁ hh₂ a b)
+
+end
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

+/-! # External Alexander--Whitney pure-tensor Leibniz calculation
+Source: Stacks Project, Tags 0BED and 07MB.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-leibniz).
+-/
+
+@[expose] public section
+universe w
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory Opposite
+open scoped TensorProduct
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
+noncomputable section
+variable {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}

+/-- The signed face calculation on a pure tensor, before tensor-total assembly.
+Source: Stacks Project, Tag 07MB, calculation after equation 20.25.3.2, coefficients in degree zero;
+Tag 0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech, for the external coordinates.
+(blueprint: lem-sc-picard-external-cech-cup-leibniz).
+Proof: Apply the target Cech coordinate equivalence and evaluate on a tuple y of
+length p+q+2. Expand the target differential as its alternating restriction sum.
+The three assumed bidegree formulas identify the cup coordinates. Naturality of
+both pullback adjunction units identifies a pulled restricted section with the
+restriction of its pullback. Presheaf composition and compatibility of tensor
+sections with restriction identify the successive restrictions on each face.
+Expand d(a) cup b and a cup d(b) using these identities and additivity. The front
+terms indexed 0 through p agree with the first p+1 target faces, with signs
+(-1)^j. The last front term and the first back term restrict the same two sections
+to the same intersection, with signs (-1)^(p+1) and (-1)^p, and cancel. The back
+terms indexed r=1 through q+1 agree with target faces p+r, with signs (-1)^(p+r).
+Splitting the target face sum at p+1 thus gives the displayed identity. The two
+degree transports only identify equal tuple lengths. Coordinate extensionality
+concludes. For p=0 or q=0 the same shared terms cancel; in characteristic two
+opposite terms still sum to zero. Empty index families have no tuples and zero
+coefficients give zero sections. This calculation makes no use of a coproduct,
+a tensor-total inclusion, or a family of maps in other bidegrees. -/
+theorem picardExternalCechCupBidegree_leibniz
+    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
+    {ι κ : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
+    (p q : ℕ)
+    (h : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
+        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
+      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
+          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + q))
+    (h₁ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
+        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X (p + 1))).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) ⟶
+      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
+          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X ((p + 1) + q))
+    (h₂ : ((curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k)).obj
+        (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)).obj (((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X (q + 1)) ⟶
+      ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
+          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X (p + (q + 1)))
+    (hh : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p q h)
+    (hh₁ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G (p + 1) q h₁)
+    (hh₂ : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G p (q + 1) h₂)
+    (a : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X p)
+    (b : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X q) :
+    ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
+          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).d
+        (p + q) (p + q + 1) (h (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) =
+      (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
+        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
+          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
+        (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q)))
+          (h₁ (((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).d p (p + 1) a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) +
+    (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • (eqToHom (congrArg (fun n ↦
+        ((picardCechFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
+        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
+          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).X n)
+        (Nat.add_assoc p q 1).symm))
+          (h₂ (a ⊗ₜ[k] ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).d q (q + 1) b)) := by
+  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
+  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false in
+    classical
+    let l := fun r s ↦ (picardExternalCechCupBidegree_exists f g U V F G r s).choose
+    have hl : ∀ r s, IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G r s (l r s) :=
+      fun r s ↦ (picardExternalCechCupBidegree_exists f g U V F G r s).choose_spec
+    have heq (r s : ℕ) (m : _)
+        (hm : IsPicardExternalCechCupBidegree f g U V F G r s m)
+        (x : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).X r)
+        (z : ((picardCechFunctor g V).obj G).X s) :
+        l r s (x ⊗ₜ[k] z) = m (x ⊗ₜ[k] z) := by
+      apply (TopCat.Presheaf.cechComplexFunctorXAddEquiv
+        (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ij.1 ⊓
+          pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ij.2)
+        (scalarPresheaf (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
+        (r + s)).injective
+      funext y
+      exact (hl r s x z y).trans (hm x z y).symm
+    have hc := picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps_comm_ι f g U V F G l hl (p + q) p q rfl
+    rw [← Category.assoc, picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps_ι] at hc
+    simp only [HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d_eq, Preadditive.add_comp,
+      Preadditive.comp_add, HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.ι_D₁_assoc,
+      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.ι_D₂_assoc] at hc
+    rw [HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₁_eq _ _ _ _ (by rfl) q (p + q + 1)
+        (Nat.add_right_comm p 1 q),
+      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.d₂_eq _ _ _ _ p (by rfl) (p + q + 1)
+        (Nat.add_assoc p q 1).symm] at hc
+    simp only [Linear.units_smul_comp, Category.assoc] at hc
+    dsimp only [picardExternalCechCupDegreeMaps] at hc
+    simp only [HomologicalComplex.ι_mapBifunctorDesc] at hc
+    have hv := congrArg (fun m ↦ m.hom (a ⊗ₜ[k] b)) hc
+    simp only [ComplexShape.ε₁_def, one_smul, ComplexShape.ε₂_def,
+      ComplexShape.ε_up_ℕ, curriedTensor_map_app, curriedTensor_obj_map] at hv
+    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ModuleCat.hom_smul,
+      LinearMap.smul_apply, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hv
+    simp only [← tensorHom_id, ← id_tensorHom] at hv
+    erw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul,
+      ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul] at hv
+    simp only [ConcreteCategory.id_apply] at hv
+    rw [heq p q h hh a b,
+      heq (p + 1) q h₁ hh₁ _ b, heq p (q + 1) h₂ hh₂ a _] at hv
+    exact hv
+
+end
+end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
